Remark
[Notation for embedded minimizing disks] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0259 ↗ def:chow-iv-disk-class-almost-piece 1. ch33:33.23\group Minimal disks

The truncation parameter is suppressed when fixed, and for an embedding $f\in \mathfrak T_A(t)$ its image disk may itself be denoted as an element of $\mathfrak T_A(t)$.
